messages:
Alicia Chen: Hey team — heads up, the A/B rollout dashboard for exp-frontend-cta looks wrong for 2026-03-01 00:00-06:00 UTC. Variant counts are reversed: UI shows Variant B ~10k users, Variant A ~2k, but assignment logs show A got ~10k. Screenshot attached. Anyone else seeing this?

Priya Kapoor: ACK. That's our largest CTA experiment right now. Can you paste the query you used to compare assignment logs vs dashboard? Also any recent deploys to analytics? :eyes:

Alicia Chen: Quick repro steps I did: 1) Pulled assignment events from assignments.events where experiment_id='exp-frontend-cta' and ts between '2026-03-01' and '2026-03-02' 2) Grouped by variant_key -> count 3) Compared to /console/rollouts/exp-frontend-cta -> metrics -> assignment counts. SQL I ran: ```SELECT variant_key, COUNT(*) FROM assignments.events WHERE experiment_id='exp-frontend-cta' AND ts >= '2026-03-01' AND ts < '2026-03-02' GROUP BY variant_key;```  Results: A: 10034, B: 2031. Dashboard shows the reverse.

Marco Ruiz: Thanks. I'm looking at the transforms for the rollout pipeline. We migrated rollout_join_v2 last night and there was a variant mapping table change (variant_keys -> display_name) that got a null default for any unmapped id. Looks like the join fell back to ordering by variant_id when display_name is null which would effectively flip labels for this experiment because variant ids are non-sequential. Running a quick check: ```SELECT variant_id, display_name, COUNT(*) FROM rollout_join_v2 WHERE experiment_id='exp-frontend-cta' AND ts >= '2026-03-01' GROUP BY 1,2;``` Might be an upstream mapping issue from onboarding script.

Alicia Chen: I ran Marco's query, output: variant_id 101 -> NULL display_name -> 10034, variant_id 102 -> 'B' -> 2031. So yeah variant 101 lost its name so dashboard showed B as 101 ordering.

Priya Kapoor: Yikes. Does this affect historical dashboards or only the new pipeline window? Any customer-facing impact?

Marco Ruiz: The bad join happened only for events processed by rollout_join_v2 after the migration cutoff at 2026-03-01T00:00 UTC. Older aggregated tables still have correct display names. So current live metrics in the console (which read from the new materialized table) are affected for that window. Customer-facing alert emails triggered yesterday used the console numbers so there was confusion.

Zoe Ops: For immediate mitigation I can roll a hotfix on the transform to coalesce display_name from the fallback mapping table before materializing. Proposed patch: ```COALESCE(mapping.display_name, CASE WHEN variant_id=101 THEN 'A' WHEN variant_id=102 THEN 'B' ELSE CONCAT('variant_', variant_id) END) AS display_name``` That will restore labels for exp-frontend-cta and similar experiments where mapping was missing. Would backfill be needed for historical metrics?

Marco Ruiz: Hotfix + backfill yes. Hotfix will fix dashboard going forward. For backfill we should re-run the materialization for the affected date range (2026-03-01 00:00 to 2026-03-02 06:00 UTC) to correct counts in the UI. I'll open a backfill job.

Alicia Chen: Thanks. Can you also confirm whether this affects rollout assignment counts used by the AB analytics SDK (the service that writes to assignments.events)? I need to know if end-user instrumentation is okay.

Marco Ruiz: SDK assignments were fine. This is only a display/transformation issue in analytics. The raw events table has correct variant keys. So no repro changes on the client side.

Priya Kapoor: Good. Please add an incident note and notify any impacted customers. Action items: Marco implements backfill + postmortem; Zoe applies hotfix to materialization; Alicia to update the support tickets with findings and corrected numbers once backfill completes. ETA on backfill?

Marco Ruiz: Backfill job queued, estimate ~45m runtime. I'll post when complete and include before/after numbers.

deploy-bot: deploy rollout_join_v2 migration completed by @Marco Ruiz at 2026-03-01T02:14:12Z :rocket:

analytics-bot: Backfill job started for exp-frontend-cta (2026-03-01 00:00 -> 2026-03-02 06:00) by @Marco Ruiz. Job id: bf-20260301-01.

Marco Ruiz: Backfill finished. Pre-backfill dashboard counts: A 2,031, B 10,034. Post-backfill: A 10,034, B 2,031. Confirmed corrected in console. I also added a migration test to ensure mapping table nulls cause a hard error instead of falling back silently.

Alicia Chen: Confirmed on my side — console now matches assignment logs. Closing customer tickets and sending clarification email. Thanks everyone. :tada:

Priya Kapoor: Added to the postmortem board. We'll include mitigation to add a schema check in the onboarding script so mapping rows are validated.

Zoe Ops: Leaving a note in oncall runbook: if rollout counts look swapped, check rollout_join_v2 mapping join and run mapping validation query.

Alicia Chen: Marking thread resolved.
